checks.description: JSON record_count (17) equals the number of records
JSONL line count equals record_count
CSV row count equals record_count
Parquet row count equals record_count
id values are unique
id is lower-case letters, digits and hyphens
ISO size-type codes are unique
ISO size-type code is 4 characters (letters and digits)
Required fields present: id, name, category, iso_type_group, height_class, nominal_length_ft, external_length_mm, external_width_mm, research_status, source_ids
Every JSON record has the same fields in the same order
CSV columns equal the JSON fields minus fields_detail
Parquet columns equal the CSV columns
category is in the published vocabulary
research_status is VERIFIED or PARTIAL
JSONL records are deep-equal to JSON records
Every CSV cell matches the JSON value (lists joined with "; ")
Every Parquet value matches the JSON value
max_payload_kg = max_gross_kg minus tare_kg
Inside dimensions are smaller than the outside dimensions
capacity_m3 is within 5% of length x width x height
source_id values are unique
Every source_ids entry exists in sources.csv
fields_detail values equal the record values and cite registered sources
Every confidence is CONFIRMED, STRONG or SUPPORTED (or empty for definitions)
Every field with a confidence cites at least one source
Every typical_cargo entry has a reason and a source
Every registered source is cited by at least one record
SHA256SUMS matches every data file
